profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Ford Motor Company
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with experience developing software that support large-scale, real-world operations. With a Master’s in Computer Science from Northeastern University and a foundation in Sociology, I bring both technical expertise and a user-centered mindset to my work.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: CS5001: Intensive Foundations of Computer Science (Spring 2022, Fall 2022)

positions.title: Library Circulation Assistant
positions.description:
- Operate library circulation database and reservation cataloging to manage the media and film resources available on campus
- Sustain interlibrary communication about resource availability with 25 libraries
-Assist high volume of patron inquiries, over the telephone and in-person, with cordiality and professionalism ensuring that they are referred to the proper resources
-Collaborate in digitization and preservation projects of diverse film formats

company.name: Media Resources Center, UC Berkeley Moffit Library

positions.title: Literacy Mentor
positions.description:
- Worked with a group of UC Berkeley students to tutor underrepresented elementary school students to improve their reading skills, as a method of building equity in the education system
- Developed personalized methods of instruction to illustrate concepts of reading, fluency, and comprehension based on each student's need; well-received by students

positions.title: U.S. Citizenship Instructor and UAC Intern
positions.description:
- Conceptualized and implemented curriculum of the U.S. citizenship exam for low-income permanent residents; assessed English-language reading, comprehension, writing, and speaking skills
- Successfully organized and created a new system for legal intakes of unaccompanied minors (UAC) to increase the efficiency of the non-profit, scheduled appointments, interviewed potential clients for legal aid eligibility; translated, filed and organized legal documents pertinent to each case

company.name: Inside the Living Room, East Bay Sanctuary Covenant

educations.fieldOfStudy: Sociology Major and Ethnic Studies Minor

courses.name: Data Structures, Algorithms, and Their Applications Within Computer Systems

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Pioneered program in Oakland International High School that pairs high school students of varying legal statuses with a mentor in higher education, to increase college admissions in underrepresented populations
- Designed inclusive scholarship & financial aid workshops that address concerns for U.S. citizens and undocumented students, to provide guidance and advise that is accessible to all students
-Mediated between school staff, mentors, and mentees to maximize the sharing of information and aid available to students
